limitations: Storage mechanics and synthetic Object callbacks only; no engine allocator, native hook, game process, installed files or secondary companion semantics are implemented or exercised.

Primary and secondary may independently allocate identical indices and generations. Handles are storage-instance-local; manually changing domain or other handle fields is not a supported operation or an authorization mechanism.
current(domain,index) intentionally resolves the current occupant and cannot reject stale index-only native IDs after reuse.
All physical pools share a growth capacity in this prototype; domain-specific native count/highwater and publication adapters remain engine integration work.
No engine constructor/destructor, worker barrier, live growth, rollback of engine side effects, or migration of original inline allocations is supplied.
Wide tests reach66049 per domain, proving no16-bit narrowing. They do not allocate beyond signed32 or exercise full uint64 generation rollover.

Callback payload allocation and construction failures are exhaustively injected for three additional test blocks; standard-library metadata/directory allocation failures are source-reviewed RAII, not fault-injected.
